correctness.rationale: Set d=|a-b| and t=|a+b-m|. Direct expansion of p=a/m,q=b/m yields H_T-H_S=d²/(2m²), H_T=(m²-t²)/(2m²), 1-H_S=(m²+d²+t²)/(2m²), hence G_ST=d²/(m²-t²), D=2d²/(m²+d²+t²). For fixed d>0 the first increases and second decreases with t. Independent rational enumeration of all strictly polymorphic pairs m=2..5 modulo population swap and joint allele exchange proves no strict reversal m<=4 and unique m=5 pair (1,2) vs (2,3), indices (1/21,1/15) vs (1/25,1/13). At m>=5 first pair (1,2) and a central adjacent pair have same d=1 and strictly separated t, proving persistence for all m, not merely finite checks.
